summary: Philip Morris International Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $750M of 4.125% Notes due 2029 and $750M of 4.875% Notes due 2036 under an existing indenture. This is a routine debt offering, not a special situation. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. Therefore, no special-situation classification applies.
